commit_note: Loopline Hinglish pilot candidate: opening once, terminal tool-before-claim, exact PTP/callback writes, three authenticated tools; preserves v18 rollback.

prompt_identity.reason: The platform editor did not expose an export or canonical prompt hash; no local hash is claimed.

observed_failures: No deployed tool call was observed on any attempt.
The agent claimed a callback was scheduled without a matching state write.
The v2 harness carried stale relative-date facts into the callback and PTP records.
The agent opened one call in Gujarati despite the Hinglish-only contract.
Conversation progression was poor because the opening and resolved asks were repeated.
claim_boundary: Version 19 is a preserved failed candidate. It is not the final improved agent and must not be presented as an accepted release.
